All boats with motors of any type and sailboats twelve (12 ) feet in length and up. Sailboats under twelve (12) feet in length, rowboats and canoes powered by sail, oars, paddles or other human power are exempt from registration requirements. All boats made after 1972 must have 12 digits in the Hull Identification Number. If there are more or less than 12 digits, you must call Marine Patrol at 293-2037 to arrange for an inspection. They will give you a boat "No Vin" verification form which you need to take to a sub-station (located in Keene or Concord) to obtain a proper 12-digit hull number. This must be completed prior to registering your boat.             Boat registration renewals: If your boat was previously registered in the State of New Hampshire, a renewal registration will be mailed to you, which you may bring to the Town Clerk's Office for completion and payment of fees. All boat registrations expire on December 31st of the current year.    New Boat purchase: You will need to present a bill of sale signed by both the seller and purchaser.  The bill of sale must contain all pertinent information on the boat; i.e. hull identification number, model year, make, type of fuel, length, etc.  A boat registration will be completed based upon this information.  Fees for the Town and State will be collected based on the year, make and length of the boat.    New Swanzey resident   Your new license reflecting your Swanzey address Two of the following: Mortgage statement Lease agreement Utility bill Piece of mail Visually impaired voters learn more about One4All by  clicking here  NOTE:  Effective January 1, 2014, the Town Clerk's Office will no longer be issuing hunting and fishing licenses.  Alternate locations to purchase a license are: Sam's Outdoor Outfitters in North Swanzey Gomarlo's Food & Circus in West Swanzey Region 4 - Fish and Game Department in Keene or online at  https://www.nhfishandgame.com Kept in the Town Clerk’s Office: Election Results Minutes of Town meetings Minutes of Town Boards and Commissions Helpful Information from the Town Clerk: Dog Licenses Election Information/Voter Registration Vehicle Registrations Vital Statistics Marriage Licenses Secretary Scanlan Informs Voters of Annual Checklist Verification Process Party Affiliation Deadline - June 2 Public Hearing Notices Agendas & Minutes Jobs Payment Tax Maps Forms Contractor Opportunities Property Records Calendar Search Stay Updated with us Subscribe SIGN UP TO GET UPDATES FROM THE TOWN Share this page × Share this page Copy and paste this code into your website.
